status: EXPLORATORY - generic provisional photometry; not product-specific, not measured, not a release

assumptions.photometry: GENERIC: point fittings = cos^m intensity, m = ln0.5/ln(cos(beam/2)) (min 0.6), catalogue lumens taken as luminaire output; strips = Lambertian 10 mm emitters at catalogue lm/m. No IES/LDT, no product LOR, no cut-off/baffle optics.
assumptions.analytic_CAL_0.85_not_applied: the analytic model multiplies direct light by an empirical 0.85; the simulation does not
assumptions.surfaces: diffuse (Radiance plastic, no specularity); reflectances per variant (paint/tile LRV unselected); floor gloss not modelled
assumptions.geometry: lighting calculation polygons extruded (not surveyed masonry); LIV+DIN one open-plan enclosure; doors/windows/curtains not modelled (walls everywhere); unfurnished except kitchen counters/wall cabinets and the CBR desk shelf
assumptions.tray_cove: tray recess at tray_h inside the tray path; cove pocket = band slab (12 mm) + lip + outer upstand; strip on the pocket floor facing up at pocket_w/2 outside the tray edge (pocket width and lip unmeasured)
assumptions.kitchen_slot: flat ceiling with a shadow slot slot_w x slot_d outside the cove path; strip on the slot inner face aimed outward (variant: down-facing); slot size unmeasured
assumptions.wall_cabinets: kitchen wall cabinets 1.45-2.20 m over cabinets_occlusion_ft boxes; base counters 0-0.90 m on the counter rule
assumptions.back_strips: TV backlight (BACK without mount height) = 0.8 m tall Lambertian panel at 0.8-1.6 m facing the nearer wall
assumptions.pooja: canonical niche (0.6096 x 1.7018 m, sill 0.4318 m, depth 0.381 m HOLD) cut into the LIV x = 2.25 ft wall; the inherited LIV-P1 strip record lies outside that cavity and is reported, not simulated

engine.name: Radiance rcontrib 6.0a (pyradiance 1.1.5 Linux wheel bundle), remote

units.xyz: metres; x = plan x_ft*0.3048, y = plan z_ft*0.3048 (sheet-down), z = height above local floor
units.E: lux, maintained (MF applied), per fixture at 100 % output

kit_worktop.rule: left run x<=4.3 ft OR top run z<=7.4 ft
